summary: The same source lowers to StringBuilder or invokedynamic. A control drops the slash only before a null argument.

subject.system: One label method compiled to two bytecode targets

change.description: The same source lowers to StringBuilder or invokedynamic. A control drops the slash only before a null argument.

notes: The independent JVM oracle covered 9 inputs on each revision. legacy mismatches were 0 for label. modern mismatches were 0 for label. changed mismatches were 3 for label.

The same Label.java produced class-file major 52 with javac 21 -source 8 -target 8 and major 65 with default JDK 21 targeting. Disassembly shows StringBuilder.append in the former and invokedynamic in the latter. Both ran on the same JDK 21 JVM. [Compiler flags, bytes and disassembly](records/bytecode.json)
